title: Which graph for that question?
instruction: For each question, choose the graph that answers it best.

items.text: How has my sleep changed over the last month?
items.why: A change over time is a trend.

items.text: Do I sleep more at the weekend or during the week?
items.why: You compare two groups side by side with bars.

items.text: What part of my screen time is games?
items.why: A part of a whole is a share.

items.text: How did my number of steps grow from September to December?
items.why: Growth over time is a trend.

items.text: Which of us three walked the most steps this week?
items.why: Three people side by side: a comparison.

items.text: What is my day made of: school, sleep, free time?
items.why: Pieces of one whole, the day, are a share.

debrief: First the question, then the graph. Change over time is a line, comparison is bars, and a share of a whole is a pie.
